author: Whatfinger
title: White House official says Trump has signed deal with Iran
text:
White House official says Trump has signed the Memorandum of Understanding with Iran
It comes after mixed reports from Iranian media, suggesting the deal had been signed electronically this evening.
Sky’s David Blevins has the latest.
Read more: https://news.sky.com/story/iran-war-latest-trump-deal-tehran-pakistan-strait-hormuz-blockade-13509565
